title: 金鯱賞の後に・『運の尽き』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru is utterly flummoxed by her loss in the Kinko Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Overcome with shock and tears, she fears that both good fortune and the gods have abandoned her. She begs me to free her from this nightmare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her tears don't stop—not even when I tell her our next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen.
